race.title: Conferences And Events At Southwell Racecourse Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: WILD GOOSE has been in good form this autumn and gets a narrow vote over the returning The Cistercian . Klitschko arrives on the back of 2 runner-up efforts and should also be on the premises. WILD GOOSE (IRE) THE CISTERCIAN (IRE) KLITSCHKO
race.bettingForecast: Wild Goose (11/4), The Cistercian (4/1), Klitschko (5/1), Manuelito (6/1), Mister Cessna (6/1), Lawrenny (7/1), He's A Latchico (14/1), Saligo Bay (16/1)
